title: 📲 Google Play Sets New Standards for Foldable-Phone Apps!
body: 📲 Google Play Sets New Standards for Foldable-Phone Apps!

Google announced new quality standards for apps on the Google Play store, taking effect in April 2027: apps must meet the minimum large-screen adaptation standards, known as Tier 3, and publish three screenshots from a foldable phone in addition to two regular phone screenshots. Apps that do not meet these standards will not be able to publish or update on the store, and may appear less in search results. Developers can already upload foldable-phone screenshots today and apply for special quality badges. Google says there are more than 580 million large-screen devices in use today.
Simply put: a foldable phone turns from a small phone into a tablet when opened; the new standards ensure the app fills the whole screen and keeps your work intact when you fold and unfold.
Do you own a foldable phone? And do your apps work well on it?
